newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises 50 points, NYSE sets trading curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises 50 points, NYSE sets trading curbs.

text.p: The Dow industrials pushed to session highs in afternoon activity on Wednesday, triggering New York Stock Exchange program trading curbs.
The Dow gained 50 points to 6637, prompting the NYSE to impose index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1438 EDT/1838 GMT.
Broader market measures remained flat to lower, with advancing and declining issues running about even. The Nasdaq Composite index was seven points lower at 1206.
